item.title: Arrest in Pleasanton mother, son killings: What we know
item.description: A San Jose man was arrested on suspicion of murder in the fatal shootings of a 67-year-old woman and her 28-year-old son inside their Pleasanton home, police said.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues.The programs are designed to help speed registered travelers through security lines. Suspending them could cause headaches for fliers.Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem said in a statement that "shutdowns have serious real world consequences."
